_help: New herbs, materials and accessories. Each needs an id (letters and digits), a name and a description: one without a name or a description is left out of the game, with a warning. 'like' borrows what a game item does, its icon and its badge; a herb's tag is Gameplay.Inventory.Consumable.<id> (a material's Materials.<id>), so pick an id the game doesn't have. 'icon' is the game's in another colour ({"tint": "#a8c4ff"}), another item's, or a PNG of your own ('pictures/my-herb.png'). An accessory is a new look of a neck, body or paw accessory ('like': 'Neck.DogCollar.1') and needs something of its own: a 'texture' (a colour or a PNG), a 'model' (OBJ or glTF), a 'place' (moved, turned, sized) or an 'opacity' (see-through glass). A herb's or a material's 'model' is how it lies on the ground. 'recipe' is what the medicine cat wants for one; 'give' is how many you start with (once). Clan Mod Studio's Items page writes all of this; docs/SDK.md, 'New items', lists every key.
